text:
Marta R.: Publish blocked for samplekit — CI failed on `typegen-regendiff` after I landed the new /users/lookup route. Logs attached, error looks like a regendiff + changelog lint failure.

Devon H.: link to the job?

Marta R.: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/job/4832 Output snippet: 
```
--- a/src/generated/types.ts
+++ b/src/generated/types.ts
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
-  email?: string | null;
+  email: string | null; // optional reorder caused by openapi property sort
```
Also the changelog linter flagged no entry for the version bump we expected.

ci-bot: pipeline status: FAILED — release-check -> changelog-lint: missing entry for 0.8.2 -> 0.9.0; typegen-regendiff: non-empty diff.

Jenna L.: Did we forget `yarn regen` in the samplekit prepublish hook? That's been flaky when openapi schema ordering changes.

Samir K.: I ran `yarn regen` locally and saw the same tiny reorder. It looks like the OpenAPI generator changed property ordering for that model. No functional change but regendiff is strict.

Devon H.: @Marta can you push a tiny changelog entry + regenerated artifacts? Quick patch should unblock publish. Otherwise we can cut a patch semver bump. :grimacing:

Marta R.: Pushed PR with changelog and regenerated types: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412 — CI requeued.

ci-bot: Build queued — running `typegen-regendiff` and `changelog-lint`.

Jenna L.: If this recurs we should add a CI step that either auto-runs `yarn regen` on OpenAPI diffs or explicitly fails with a clearer message and a link to the regen command. I'll open a ticket.

Samir K.: Filing a small RFC/ticket for regen-autofix: https://go/redwood/regen-autofix-2024 — suggests opt-in autofix runner and a non-strict regendiff mode for formatting-only diffs.

Devon H.: Thanks — keeping this one short. If CI passes I'll merge the PR and reattempt the publish.

Marta R.: thx all :thumbsup:
